scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "cd backend && pnpm dev" "cd frontend && pnpm dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "cd backend && pnpm start" "cd frontend && pnpm dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --dir backend build && pnpm --dir frontend build
scripts.install:all: pnpm install && pnpm --dir backend install && pnpm --dir frontend install
